about: Meshy text-to-3D jobs for Bug's-Eye View. Each id matches a SkinAnchor model_id in the game; the generated model is saved as assets/models/<id>.glb and swapped in automatically. Prompts get the style suffix appended. Tier 1 = characters, threats, bug food and crumb gems, 2 = cover/props/lures, 3 = furniture.
style: Stylized realistic 3D game asset, clean readable silhouette, single isolated object, centered, no base, no ground plane, no background, no text.
